---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
hr_by_season <- Teams |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(
    total_home_runs = sum(HR),
    total_team_games = sum(G)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    home_runs_per_game = total_home_runs / total_team_games,
    season_type = if_else(
      yearID %in% c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020),
      "Shortened seasons",
      "Other seasons"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(hr_by_season, aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs_per_game)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), color = "gray70") +
  geom_point(aes(color = season_type), size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Other seasons" = "#4E79A7", "Shortened seasons" = "#E15759"),
    name = "Season type"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Home Runs per Team-Game by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs per team-game",
    caption = "Source: Lahman database"
  )
```

```{r}
Teams |>
  filter(yearID %in% c(1981, 1994, 2019, 2020)) |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(
    total_home_runs = sum(HR),
    total_team_games = sum(G),
    home_runs_per_game = total_home_runs / total_team_games
  ) |>
  arrange(yearID) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```
